title: Evidence Repository for Forensic Readiness of Persistent-Memory LLM Agents

creators.name: Islam, Md Rashedul
creators.affiliation: School of Information Technology, Deakin University

description: Study-selection records, coding matrices, supplementary tables, and reproducibility checks supporting a structured scoping survey and systematisation of knowledge on persistent-memory LLM-agent forensic readiness.
notes: The repository does not redistribute reviewed paper PDFs. Independent second-coder agreement is not included in this release candidate.
